flagged_before_onset.definition: % of EMS-mapped flood area whose ~90 m TPI cell was already Alto+ (>0.4) / Critico (>0.6) in: observed = series band dated 2024-04-29 (rain Apr 26-28, all information before the 04-29 03Z onset); gfs = the GFS 00Z runs issued 2024-04-26/27/28, max over d1..d3 frames depicting dates <= the onset day (tools/warned_before.py evaluate/by_lead logic)

flood_ems_method: Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping activation EMSR720 (event GLIDE FL-2024-000063-BRA, activated 2024-05-03) mapped the May 2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods with semi-automatic SAR delineation (DEL products: COSMO-SkyMed, RADARSAT-2, PAZ) and photo-interpreted optical grading (GRA: Pleiades Neo, GeoEye-1, WorldView-3) on five small Taquari-valley AOIs — Guapore, Encantado, Roca Sales, Das Antas Dam, Santa Tereza. All '5-Flood' polygons (observedEventA 'Flooded area' and 'Flood trace', plus DEL_MONIT 'Maximum flood extent') were unioned per AOI+image date, minus the BLP hydrographyA permanent/reference-water layer, rasterized centre-in onto the ~90 m TPI_flood grid (area-weighted variant at >=50% coverage reported alongside), and scored ONLY inside the EMS AOI extents. IMPORTANT COVERAGE LIMIT: the EMS AOIs cover ~51.6-51.9 W, 29.0-29.3 S — Porto Alegre, Guaiba, Canoas, Eldorado do Sul and Sao Leopoldo were never mapped, so every score is Taquari-valley-only evidence, not AOI-wide. For each EMS image date E, IoU/F1/precision/recall compare EMS flood cells with TPI_flood Alto+ (>0.4) and Critico (>0.6) in (a) the observed band dated E (rain days E-3..E-1) and (b) the GFS 00Z run issued 24 h before E restricted to frames depicting dates <= E. 'Flagged before onset' measures the % of the EMS flood footprint already Alto+/Critico in the observed band dated 2024-04-29 and in the GFS runs issued 2024-04-26/27/28 (onset 2024-04-29 03:00Z; tools/warned_before.py evaluate/by_lead). Caveats: EMS polygons are imagery-mapped extent at a moment — they miss flooding under cloud/vegetation, GRA 'Flood trace' marks earlier water no longer present, and the EMS image date E pairs loosely with our frame convention (observed band E = rain E-3..E-1, GFS frames depicting E = rain E-2..E; docs/conventions-dates.md).
